  WHY: The merge gate can proceed despite a real CI failure. Both reviewers rated this MAJOR; the severity is mapped to high. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 examined the same concern and dropped it as a pre-existing trust-model property that the owner accepted.

  PROBLEM: The README `AUTO_MERGE_REQUIRED_CI_CHECK` row documents only the cancelled-run exception, not the new exception for an older non-success run superseded by a newer bound success.
  WHY: Operator documentation contradicts the merge gate's behavior. All reviewers rated it NIT.

  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]

  WHY: Two adjacent sections of the canonical maintainer reference disagree. Both reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:65-71, 788-801 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The header comments (the PR_CHECKS_JQ_SUPERSEDE_DEFS / PR_CHECKS_LAST_CI_STATE comment at lines 65-71 and the `_pr_wait_for_required_checks` named-CI-check block at lines 788-801) still say every such run must succeed and mention only the cancelled-run exception.
  WHY: The comments are stale against the new supersession rule and can mislead maintainers. All reviewers rated it NIT.

- README.md (AUTO_MERGE_REQUIRED_CI_CHECK section) | severity=low | confidence=5

  WHY: The doc mismatch misleads operators and maintainers.

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:147-148, 883-889, 930-938 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The success override trusts CI runs identified by workflow name, not workflow file. A same-repo PR can add a workflow named `CI` with a successful `lint` check, which causes an older failed CI `lint` check to be dropped.
  WHY: `_pr_checks_completed` can return success and let the merge gate proceed although the real CI check failed.
- README.md:158; agents.md:2920; scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:788-796 | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: These descriptions still say every matching run must succeed and that any failed, skipped, neutral or cancelled run blocks the wait.
  WHY: The documentation contradicts the merge gate's behavior and can mislead diagnosis.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
